column1: Yandy Diaz leads the slate with a strong hit probability and steady contact rates, facing Sean Manaea at home with the platoon edge and a slight park boost. Jake McCarthy offers similar reliability atop Colorado’s lineup, also benefiting from a favorable matchup and an even better park factor. Junior Caminero and Freddie Freeman both bring recent consistency and the platoon advantage, but Diaz’s track record and matchup make him the top choice for Beat The Streak players today.
